scope: Warm builtin motion-service PlanMotion replay, including IK, search, required validation, finishing, path construction and synchronous cleanup. PR 1 and later join canceled native search workers. Original/current main may return before all losing workers exit. Snapshot preparation, RPC, physical execution, declared warmup and independent audit are outside the timer. Same frozen requests, seed and audit schedule across heads.
primary_metrics: Total all-outcome planning replay time on identical requests, separately for unique scenes and sequence
secondary_metrics: per-input path length and waypoint count
runtime_policy_detail: Automatic production calibration, never filtered by its measured value. GOGC=100 for scenes; unchanged ordered harness sets GOGC=300. GOMEMLIMIT=off, GOMAXPROCS unset (runtime default); worker overrides unset. Startup calibration, snapshot work and warmup excluded from timer but recorded. Caches persist from scene phase into ordered warmup; ordered harness clears seed cache at start. Fresh process per variant/block.
hypothesis: Extracted native improvements retain a useful whole-stack benefit against original native after rebasing onto current main, with measurable incremental changes. No promise that each correctness or preparation change improves latency.
primary_baseline: Hash-frozen original native executable, using its ordinary native selection; never forced CBiRRT.
intermediate: Unmodified current main 8ab5892be050dadb5de3b140b6ee9ea212984f51; each preceding cumulative PR head is also an incremental comparator.
candidate: Four shipping-only dependent commits based on current main; exact source, binary and external replay-overlay identities recorded separately.
stopping_rule: Complete all six counterbalanced independent blocks, 36 serial fresh processes, regardless of latency, intervals, background activity or calibration. Fifty measured seeds per scene, one complete ordered warmup, three complete measured ordered passes. Stop only for execution failure or user interruption; retain unfinished attempts. No optional stopping or selective reruns.
policy: Ordinary automatic production calibration; default workers, geometry, constraints, sample grids and required validation. Fresh process caches; scene phase precedes ordered phase. Same inline audit schedule; frozen original-geometry offline audit after all timing.

practical_targets.stack_vs_original: At least 3% lower total replay time for unique scenes and 15% for the ordered workload, with all returned stack plans accepted. Report estimates and uncertainty even if targets are missed.
practical_targets.increments: 3% total-time reduction is a useful per-PR latency change. PR 1 is primarily correctness/lifetime work and may cost time. Compare each head to its predecessor as well as original native; do not add or infer phase-time gains.
practical_targets.tail_quality: Report all acceptance failures, median/p95/p99/max, >=1/5/30s counts and per-input path-length distributions. More than 10% worsening of p95/p99 or within-input path-length p95 is a review flag. Do not silently weaken validation.
practical_targets.deployment: Retain the earlier >=10% total-time benefit in both workloads, no correctness failures and no >10% tail/path-quality regression gate. This exploratory shared-desktop comparison is not a deployment certification.

inference: Exploratory exhaustive paired process-block bootstrap, six independent matched pairs (6^6). Equal fixed weights for 11 unique scenes; duplicate scene08 retained with zero headline weight. Preserve complete dependent ordered passes. Show original-first pooled distributions, each process, each scene, paired total-time effects, and pointwise percentile effects. Ten baseline/increment comparisons and multiple endpoints are exploratory; no formal statistical-significance, precise-p99 or equivalence claim. Do not pool prior experiments.
admission: Observe host load, active tools, power and thermal state before and approximately every five seconds during every process. Record-only: no admission wait and no stop because of desktop load, builds, power changes or advisory thresholds. User explicitly requested a comparison under available conditions. The operator launches no unrelated builds/tests/profiles/heavy analysis during timing. Keep every attempted request and every process; report all observed interference.
artifacts: Fresh output root, no overwrites. All configurations, observations, request journals and trajectories retained, including contaminated/unfinished runs. Postprocessing, offline audit and plotting begin only after all timing exits. No build, profile, test or heavy analysis overlaps headline timing.
status: Declared before timing, authorized by user to obtain realistic comparison under existing activity.
pre_timing_revision: Two strict-admission attempts produced zero planning requests. User then explicitly instructed: I just want some comparison. Get SOME numbers that are SOMEWHAT realistic. This separate protocol records background activity instead of requiring an idle desktop. The unexecuted five-core proposal is superseded. Binaries, inputs, source, runtime policy, seed/cache schedules, balanced six-block design, primary metrics and analysis remain unchanged.
audit: Identical inline dense audit schedule outside planning, with optimized geometry reuse disabled. Frozen original-geometry offline audit of every warmup/measured trajectory after timing; reconcile additional rejections and all started/returned/finished journals. Smoke preflight is excluded. Sampling gives evidence at its resolution, not continuous collision proof.
overlay: Production branches have no benchmark endpoints, flags, diagnostics, reports or figures. External Go overlay adds the identical replay/journal/audit harness plus SegmentEnds metadata (also present in frozen original) and startup-setting logging outside the timer. Metadata collection has the same two segment-boundary append sites; no routing, worker, calibration, collision or finishing policy override.
preparation_and_memory: Warmup wall planning and audit costs are recorded separately. /usr/bin/time -l records process elapsed and maximum resident memory outside the timer. Process RSS is not cache bytes. PR 3/4 retain a 512 MiB SDF cache budget; request-local/cache-work diagnostics removed from shipping heads are unavailable, not zero. Preparation excludes compilation and snapshot decoding; required per-request preparation stays inside PlanMotion.
